hq_location.notes: CompanyCam identifies Lincoln, Nebraska as its headquarters.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center contains many documentation collections, including getting started, integrations, and AI tools.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2025 Series C falls within the 18-month period beginning May 9, 2025.

founded_year.notes: CompanyCam's press information gives its founding year as 2015.

last_funding.notes: The Series C transaction was announced in August 2025. The company did not disclose the amount; reporting attributed a $415 million total to PitchBook data.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog and press history did not show a product or major-feature launch dated May 9–November 9, 2026. The identifiable launch-related press items found were earlier than this six-month window; routine educational posts and help-documentation updates were not counted as launches.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists and describes pricing plans.

employee_band.notes: The employee profile reports about 400 employees in June 2026; CompanyCam's press page also describes a workforce of over 200.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current listing marked four days old advertises an Inside Sales Representative role at CompanyCam, which is a sales-representative title.

model_provider.notes: Checked the public AI documentation and trust/security information; these sources describe AI features but do not name the model or model provider.

named_customers.notes: Both are presented in CompanyCam customer case studies.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists openings, but the titles shown are not AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision roles.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center explicitly says SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. GDPR is listed because it is one of the requested named compliance categories; no other requested certification was identified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integration page identifies HighLevel, JobNimbus, and JobTread integrations; CompanyCam's CRM integration article names HubSpot and Salesforce.

product_one_liner.notes: The company describes photo documentation, job progress tracking, and field-to-office coordination for contractors.
product_one_liner.value: CompanyCam is a photo-based jobsite documentation and productivity platform for contractors and field-service teams to capture and organize project photos, track work, and coordinate crews and the office.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A public profile shows CompanyCam's Chief People Officer started in June 2025, outside the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window. I could not verify a sufficiently complete leadership roster or a departure announcement to establish whether any other C-level or VP-level change occurred.
